D: Two metalhead friends get their public access cable show picked up by a slick producer.
P: Serve the snacks when Bohemian Rhapsody comes on in the Mirthmobile.
S: Glazed and chocolate doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes until glossy, served in a cardboard box with napkins.
Cheese puffs, pretzels and red liquorice tipped into a big bowl to pass round the back seat.
Wayne refuses to do product placement, while holding the box
Mini pepperoni pizzas on rounds of dough, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, presented to the camera with a cheesy grin.
M: held up to camera, label facing out
Pepperoni and mushroom pizza: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella, pepperoni and sliced mushroom, on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares.
Franks simmered then griddled until blistered, in steamed buns with yellow mustard, sweet relish and chopped onion.
W: Choux dough piped in rings onto baking paper, fried at 180C until puffed, dipped in a thin honey glaze.
K: held up for the viewers at home
Cola over ice in a big glass, held at the correct angle.

s.how: Warm 4 glazed and 4 chocolate doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes until the glaze turns glossy. Pack them into a cardboard box lined with napkins and pass it around the couch.

s.note: Wayne refuses to do product placement, while holding the box
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread each with pizza sauce, add grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes. Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.

m.note: held up to camera, label facing out
m.how: Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel or tray at the oven's highest heat for 7 minutes and cut into squares.

w.how: Boil 250ml water with 100g butter, beat in 150g flour and cook a minute. Cool, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe rings onto squares of baking paper and fry at 180C, paper and all, until puffed. Dip in 200g icing sugar whisked with 2 tbsp honey and water.

d.note: held up for the viewers at home
d.how: Fill four big glasses with ice and pour a 375ml can of cola into each. Hold the can beside your face with the label to camera, smile and say nothing. Then drink.
